verdicts.why: Agent Carter has seasons on file (Agent Carter S1, S2 in the title list), and the brief makes a season the title for such a show, so the bare umbrella is not a separate title to check and needs no stages of its own.
Same as item 0: the show's seasons are the titles, so the umbrella is covered by the S1/S2 stages; no stages under the bare 'Agent Carter'.
Dugan meets Peggy with the Howling Commandos for the raid on the Leviathan complex; a girl stabs Dugan and shoots Juniper.
Simmons injects the odium-raging Kasius with Ava's deafening implant before he kills Mack, letting Mack slay him (5x10).

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#22
value.text: Fitz goes back into Qovas' ship to save Mack from two Remorath. When Fitz is buried under rubble in Chicago, Mack digs him out and stays at his side, crying, as he dies.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Mack's closest friend, who dies with Mack beside him in Chicago.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's closest friend, who stays with him as he dies.

verdicts.why: Events are right (Fitz and May save Mack from two Remorath; Mack and May dig Fitz out and stay, crying, as he dies), but sources only say Mack stays at his side, not that Fitz dies in Mack's arms.
Mack and May clear the rubble over Fitz and, both crying, stay at his side until he dies (5x22).
Piper finds Mack locked in a cell, and the two take Deke to surgery and save him (5x17).

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#14
value.text: May finds that Hale's driver, taken aboard the Zephyr, is Creel in a bomb belt, ready to blow up the plane unless Hale goes free.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who catches him wearing a bomb on the Zephyr.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Hale's driver, who threatens to blow up the Zephyr.

verdicts.why: Text is right (May finds Hale's driver is Creel in a bomb belt, 5x14), but the card lines are swapped: a is Creel, so a's card must describe May and b's card Creel.
Daisy and James Davis fly a Quinjet to the Retreat, where Robin is hiding (5x16).
As Daisy and Hale calm Ruby, Yo-Yo slits Ruby's throat with the chakram, and Daisy blames her for the killing (5x18).
Kasius interrogates Daisy and Simmons with the telepath Ben; their stories match and they convince him they came alone (5x4).
Fitz, as the Doctor, straps Daisy down and forcibly extracts her inhibitor while she says she will never forgive him; her powers then seal the rift (5x14).
Daisy and May secretly asked Caine to look into Project Deathlok for Coulson; Daisy leaves and May says she will cover for her at the Lighthouse (5x19).
Daisy's final talk with Deke is interrupted by Piper, who tells them Talbot is attacking Chicago (5x22).
Keep the kind friend (as in item 11): the inhibitor removal is a one-off betrayal, not the through-line, and they remain on the same team through S5 and S6; no separate stage.
In the Remorath siege, Yo-Yo, Davis and Piper fight to keep the Remorath from the Gravitonium (5x19).
Simmons, Piper and Davis are guarding the gravitonium in the lab when the Remorath attack (5x19).
Davis, rescued by Deathlok, comes to the Lighthouse with the other agents Deke gathered and attends Fitz and Simmons' wedding (5x12); a wedding scene with him as guest shows the tie.
Yo-Yo, Davis and Piper hold off the Remorath from the Gravitonium together (5x19).
After the argument with Mack over killing Ruby, Yo-Yo talks with May, who advises her on how to cope (5x19).

Enoch stays hidden on the Zephyr and offers his life to power the damaged machine that returns the team to the present (5x10); the show treats this Enoch as the same person (Simmons recalls his sacrifice in S6). Ally fits until the S6 friend stage.

A 5x16 flashback shows Raina saying the Gravitonium wants Quinn and releasing it to absorb him; he is the second voice that Hall's voice argues with in Creel's head (5x16), and the show treats both as consciousnesses inside it (5x18).
While Daisy and Hale try to calm Ruby, May extracts Fitz and Simmons from the Hydra facility (5x18).
Simmons gives Coulson the Centipede serum; he refuses to take it, hides it in Daisy's gauntlets, then says farewell and leaves for Tahiti (5x22).
Simmons, Piper and Davis guard the gravitonium in the lab during the siege (5x19).
Hall never deals with Coulson: Hall's memories and the voices in Creel's head only reach Coulson through Creel's own words and attack, which is a mention, not an exchange between Hall and Coulson.
Quinn is only one of the voices Creel reports agreeing that Coulson should die; there is no exchange between Quinn and Coulson in S5.
While rescuing Polly and Robin, Fitz is mortally wounded by debris, and May and Mack stay by his side as he dies (5x22).
After helping Coulson seal the rift, Deathlok attends Fitz and Simmons' wedding at the Lighthouse (5x12); a scene together as wedding guest, though no direct exchange.
Fitz gives Coulson the Gravity Containment Device and Coulson has him promise he and Simmons will marry; afterward Coulson and Deke walk Fitz to his wedding (5x12).
Piper, in a deal with Hale, tricks the team into investigating the Kree beacon, holds Coulson, Fitz and Simmons at gunpoint, then helps them escape once Ruby orders them killed (5x11).
May and Daisy go outside to check an incoming Quinjet carrying the reinforcements Deke gathered, led by Deathlok, who goes down and helps Coulson close the rift (5x12).

Piper tells May she looked everywhere and even had eyes on their families (May: 'one more thing for my mother to be paranoid about'), then reveals her deal with Hale before helping the team escape (5x11).
A Quinjet docks with the Zephyr revealing Ivanov works with Hale; he demands Hale's release, May threatens him and objects, and Coulson goes with them (5x14).
Deathlok attends Fitz and Simmons' wedding after helping seal the rift (5x12), chatting with Deke about Simmons' ring; a scene together as wedding guest.
